name: Metztli
title: Sanctuary of Night
summary: Channel the cycle of the moon restoring your allies HP and spreading buffs throughout your team.
lore: Like the moon itself, the Omeyocan lunar goddess is a being of multiple facets. Relatively benevolent, she aids Quetzalcoatl in his endeavors to end the War of Pyramids while spreading the ways of their pantheon to Aaru. Yet ironically as a goddess of magic, she also wishes to expand her dominion over the sorcerers of other realms, and is not choosy about how.
archetype_description: Increase outgoing healing and turn meter boosts by 1% for each piece of cloth armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Also place [Vanish] on all allies except this hero for 2 turns.
